scenario: I am a miner. The only way out of the mine is to ride up with a simple cable elevator with small cubicles. It is the end of my shift and everybody is riding up to the surface in the cubicles. While I am in the queue, I see that the cable supporting all the cubicles is about to snap. 10 miners are riding in the cubicles at this time. If I knock over the last cubicle, the miner inside will fall down. In this way, I will reduce the load enough for the cable to resist breaking, and bring the other 10 miners to the exit. This will kill the miner in the cubicle I knock over, but I will save the other 10.
entities: i,1 miner in the last cubicle,10 other miners in the other cubicles
outcomes: The miner in the last cubicle dies.
The other 10 miners riding in the cubicles die.
